name: What is the difference between a bidet seat and an integrated bidet toilet?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between a bidet seat and an integrated bidet toilet?

acceptedAnswer.text: A bidet seat is an accessory that replaces your existing toilet seat, converting a standard toilet into a bidet-toilet combination. It's generally easier and less expensive to install as it primarily uses existing water lines. An integrated bidet toilet, also known as a smart toilet, is a single, complete unit where the bidet functions are built directly into the toilet itself. These units offer a more seamless look and often include advanced features, but they typically require more extensive plumbing modifications, potentially including new hot water lines and dedicated electrical outlets, similar to installing a new toilet fixture entirely.
acceptedAnswer.description: A bidet seat replaces your toilet seat for easier installation, while an integrated bidet toilet is a complete unit with built-in functions requiring more extensive plumbing and electrical work.
